about: Field packs in dictation (FIN-890): .build/release/ReadAloud --test-dictation Tests/dictation/packs.json. The fixture is ../g2p/pack-fixtures (the tech pack, finance and medicine with pack_only entries) with ../g2p/pack-fixtures/user as your own folder. Context is per pack: a gated term needs an evidence hit from its own pack within 12 words (con tango → contango next to EBITDA, not next to Kubernetes). A pack-only entry of a pack that's off takes no part; with its pack on it stands in for the general entry with its spelling (finance's bps for the tech list's). Your own entries count for every pack. Each case says which packs are on (none by default). must_change cases whose out equals in check that the fixture leaves them alone, where the app's real tech list would not.
